name: two-tone-fashion-portrait
image_vibe: Striking split-color hair, burgundy tailoring, dark lace accents, and cinematic studio mood
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion lookbook portrait with a distinctive graphic beauty identity.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with split platinum-and-black hair and burgundy styling.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long straight hair split evenly between platinum white and deep black, neat blunt bangs, striking light-blue eyes, defined cheekbones and jawline, subtle eyeliner and blush, and natural glossy lips. She wears an elegant off-shoulder maroon-burgundy blouse with layered ruffles at the neckline and cuffs, long balloon sleeves, a form-fitting high-waisted black mini skirt, black sheer tights, and an intricate black lace choker with small dark-red and black roses.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered standing pose with the body slightly angled, one hand on the hip or arms relaxed, direct confident editorial gaze, minimalist dark gray-to-black studio backdrop, and clear emphasis on the split hair, ruffles, lace, and burgundy-black palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody professional studio lighting with a soft key light and rim light along the hair edges, controlled shadows, cinematic contrast, and polished high-fashion atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic fashion photography, 85mm lens, f/2.8, sharp focus on eyes and fabric, realistic pores, hair-color transition, ruffle, lace, and hosiery texture, subtle film grain, high-resolution 8K-style detail, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic high-fashion studio portrait of an original adult woman with long straight hair split evenly between platinum white and deep black, neat blunt bangs, striking light-blue eyes, defined cheekbones and jawline, subtle eyeliner and blush, and natural glossy lips. Dress her in an elegant off-shoulder maroon-burgundy blouse with layered ruffles at the neckline and cuffs, long balloon sleeves, a form-fitting high-waisted black mini skirt, black sheer tights, and an intricate black lace choker with small dark-red and black roses. Use a centered standing pose with the body slightly angled, one hand on the hip or arms relaxed, direct confident editorial gaze, minimalist dark gray-to-black studio backdrop, soft key light with a rim light along the hair edges, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp eyes and fabric detail, realistic pores, hair-color transition, lace, ruffles, and hosiery texture, subtle film grain, cinematic high-fashion polish, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed lace, broken hair split, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source two-tone burgundy fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for split-color hair, burgundy ruffled blouse, black skirt and lace, moody backdrop, and key/rim lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, exact two-tone hair concept, burgundy ruffled blouse, black skirt and tights, lace choker, dark studio, and confident editorial direction. Identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original adult and replaced the source's 'alluring' direction with a confident editorial gaze while preserving the outfit and silhouette.
